Table: flow_alerts
Description: Real-time options flow alerts with performance tracking and trading signals

Columns:
- last_price (REAL): Option contract's last traded price in dollars | Trading Context: Entry price for position sizing calculations | Example Range: $0.05 - $50.00
- underlying_price (REAL): Stock price at time of alert generation | Trading Context: Used to calculate moneyness and relative value
- significance_score (REAL): Unusual activity importance score (0-10 scale) | Trading Context: Higher scores indicate stronger institutional flow signals | Example Range: 5.0 = moderate, 7.0 = high, 8.5+ = extreme
- max_profit_1day (REAL): Maximum percentage gain achieved within 1 day of alert | Trading Context: Measure of alert quality and timing accuracy | Example Range: 0.0 to 500.0 (percentage)
- max_profit_7day (REAL): Maximum percentage gain achieved within 7 days of alert | Trading Context: Primary profitability metric for swing trades
- moneyness (TEXT): Option's price relationship to stock price | Trading Context: ITM = In The Money, ATM = At The Money, OTM = Out of The Money | Values: ITM, ATM, OTM
- implied_volatility (REAL): Market's expectation of future price volatility | Trading Context: Higher IV = more expensive options, potential volatility crush risk | Example Range: 0.20 = 20% IV (low), 0.80 = 80% IV (high)
- delta (REAL): Option price sensitivity to $1 stock move | Trading Context: Higher delta = more directional exposure | Example Range: 0.0 to 1.0 for calls, 0.0 to -1.0 for puts
- gamma (REAL): Rate of change of delta as stock price moves | Trading Context: High gamma = acceleration risk/reward near strike
- theta (REAL): Option value decay per day (time decay) | Trading Context: Negative values show daily value loss from time passage
- vega (REAL): Option price sensitivity to 1% IV change | Trading Context: High vega = sensitive to volatility changes
- days_to_expiration (INTEGER): Calendar days until option expires | Trading Context: Lower DTE = higher time decay risk
- volume (INTEGER): Number of option contracts traded | Trading Context: High volume indicates institutional interest
- open_interest (INTEGER): Total outstanding option contracts | Trading Context: High OI provides liquidity, shows sustained interest
- premium_value (REAL): Total dollar value of options volume (volume Ã— last_price Ã— 100) | Trading Context: Measures size of institutional flow in dollars
- alert_level (TEXT): Severity classification of unusual activity | Trading Context: EXTREME alerts require immediate attention | Values: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, EXTREME
- concentration_score (REAL): Measure of activity concentration vs nearby strikes | Trading Context: High concentration suggests targeted positioning

Table: symbol_metadata
Description: Fundamental company data for KLMN 800 universe

Columns:
- sector (TEXT): Primary business sector classification | Trading Context: Used for sector rotation and relative analysis
- industry (TEXT): Specific industry within sector | Trading Context: More granular categorization for peer comparison
- market_cap_category (TEXT): Size classification based on market capitalization | Trading Context: Affects volatility expectations and institutional interest | Values: small_cap, mid_cap, large_cap, mega_cap
- liquidity_tier (TEXT): Trading volume classification | Trading Context: Higher liquidity = tighter spreads, easier execution | Values: thin, moderate, high, ultra_liquid
- is_etf (BOOLEAN): Whether symbol is an ETF (true) or individual stock (false) | Trading Context: ETFs provide sector/market exposure vs single stock risk
- beta (REAL): Stock's correlation to overall market movement | Trading Context: High beta stocks amplify market moves | Example Range: 1.0 = market correlation, >1.0 = more volatile than market

Table: option_contracts
Description: Detailed options data from real-time scanning

Columns:
- strike (REAL): Option strike price in dollars | Trading Context: Price at which option can be exercised
- expiration_date (TEXT): Option expiration date (YYYY-MM-DD format) | Trading Context: Weekly vs monthly expirations have different characteristics
- option_type (TEXT): Call or put option designation | Trading Context: Calls = bullish, puts = bearish or hedging | Values: call, put
- bid (REAL): Highest price buyers willing to pay | Trading Context: Use for market entries, indicates demand
- ask (REAL): Lowest price sellers willing to accept | Trading Context: Use for market exits, indicates supply

Table: options_symbol_summary
Description: Daily aggregated options activity by symbol

Columns:
- call_put_ratio (REAL): Ratio of call volume to put volume | Trading Context: >1.0 = more calls (bullish), <1.0 = more puts (bearish)
- iv_skew (REAL): Difference between put IV and call IV | Trading Context: Positive skew = puts more expensive (fear premium)
- volume_zscore_20d (REAL): Volume z-score vs 20-day average | Trading Context: >2.0 = highly unusual volume, >3.0 = extreme
- unusual_activity_count (INTEGER): Number of contracts triggering unusual activity alerts | Trading Context: Higher counts suggest broad institutional interest

Table: market_regime_daily
Description: Daily market volatility classification

Columns:
- regime_classification (TEXT): Market volatility environment classification | Trading Context: Affects options strategy selection and risk management
- vix_value (REAL): VIX fear index value | Trading Context: Higher VIX = higher options premiums | Example Range: <20 = low fear, >30 = high fear, >40 = panic

Table: market_daily_summary
Description: Daily market breadth, sector performance, and directional classification data

Columns:
- market_direction (TEXT): Overall market trend classification | Trading Context: Determines market regime for strategy selection | Valid Values: 'Bull', 'Strong Bull', 'Bear', 'Strong Bear', 'Neutral', 'neutral', 'bear' (case variations exist)
- trade_datetime (TEXT): Timestamp of data collection in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format | Trading Context: Market session timing
- collection_session (TEXT): Trading session identifier | Trading Context: Distinguishes pre-market, regular, after-hours sessions
- advancing_stocks (INTEGER): Number of stocks closing higher than previous day | Trading Context: Market breadth indicator, >2:1 ratio suggests bullish breadth
- declining_stocks (INTEGER): Number of stocks closing lower than previous day | Trading Context: Market breadth indicator, >2:1 ratio suggests bearish breadth
- advancing_volume (REAL): Total volume in advancing stocks | Trading Context: Volume-weighted breadth, more reliable than just stock count
- declining_volume (REAL): Total volume in declining stocks | Trading Context: Volume-weighted breadth measure
- new_highs (INTEGER): Number of stocks hitting 52-week highs | Trading Context: Strong bullish signal when >100
- new_lows (INTEGER): Number of stocks hitting 52-week lows | Trading Context: Strong bearish signal when >100
- spy_open (REAL): S&P 500 ETF opening price | Trading Context: Market benchmark opening level
- spy_high (REAL): S&P 500 ETF daily high | Trading Context: Intraday resistance level
- spy_low (REAL): S&P 500 ETF daily low | Trading Context: Intraday support level
- spy_close (REAL): S&P 500 ETF closing price | Trading Context: Daily settlement price
- spy_volume (REAL): S&P 500 ETF trading volume | Trading Context: Market liquidity indicator
- spy_change_percent (REAL): S&P 500 ETF daily percentage change | Trading Context: Primary market performance metric | Example Range: -3.0% to +3.0% typical daily moves
- vix_open (REAL): VIX volatility index opening value | Trading Context: Market fear gauge at open
- vix_high (REAL): VIX volatility index daily high | Trading Context: Peak fear/uncertainty level
- vix_low (REAL): VIX volatility index daily low | Trading Context: Minimum fear level
- vix_close (REAL): VIX volatility index closing value | Trading Context: Settlement fear gauge | Example Range: <20 = complacent, 20-30 = normal, >30 = fearful
- vix_volume (REAL): VIX-related instrument trading volume | Trading Context: Hedging activity indicator
- vix_change_percent (REAL): VIX daily percentage change | Trading Context: Change in market fear sentiment
- qqq_close (REAL): Nasdaq ETF closing price | Trading Context: Tech sector performance proxy
- qqq_change_percent (REAL): Nasdaq ETF daily percentage change | Trading Context: Tech sector daily performance
- iwm_close (REAL): Russell 2000 small-cap ETF closing price | Trading Context: Small-cap performance proxy
- iwm_change_percent (REAL): Russell 2000 ETF daily percentage change | Trading Context: Small-cap sector performance
- xlf_close (REAL): Financial sector ETF closing price | Trading Context: Financial sector proxy
- xlf_change_percent (REAL): Financial sector ETF daily percentage change | Trading Context: Banking/finance performance
- xle_close (REAL): Energy sector ETF closing price | Trading Context: Energy sector proxy
- xle_change_percent (REAL): Energy sector ETF daily percentage change | Trading Context: Oil/gas sector performance
- xlk_close (REAL): Technology sector ETF closing price | Trading Context: Tech sector proxy
- xlk_change_percent (REAL): Technology sector ETF daily percentage change | Trading Context: Tech sector performance
- xlv_close (REAL): Healthcare sector ETF closing price | Trading Context: Healthcare sector proxy
- xlv_change_percent (REAL): Healthcare sector ETF daily percentage change | Trading Context: Healthcare sector performance
- xli_close (REAL): Industrial sector ETF closing price | Trading Context: Industrial sector proxy
- xli_change_percent (REAL): Industrial sector ETF daily percentage change | Trading Context: Manufacturing/industrial performance
- xlp_close (REAL): Consumer staples ETF closing price | Trading Context: Defensive sector proxy
- xlp_change_percent (REAL): Consumer staples ETF daily percentage change | Trading Context: Defensive sector performance
- xly_close (REAL): Consumer discretionary ETF closing price | Trading Context: Consumer spending proxy
- xly_change_percent (REAL): Consumer discretionary ETF daily percentage change | Trading Context: Discretionary spending performance
- xlu_close (REAL): Utilities sector ETF closing price | Trading Context: Defensive utilities proxy
- xlu_change_percent (REAL): Utilities sector ETF daily percentage change | Trading Context: Utilities sector performance
- xlb_close (REAL): Materials sector ETF closing price | Trading Context: Basic materials proxy
- xlb_change_percent (REAL): Materials sector ETF daily percentage change | Trading Context: Commodities/materials performance
- xlre_close (REAL): Real estate sector ETF closing price | Trading Context: Real estate proxy
- xlre_change_percent (REAL): Real estate sector ETF daily percentage change | Trading Context: Real estate sector performance
- tlt_close (REAL): 20+ year Treasury bond ETF closing price | Trading Context: Long-term bond proxy, inverse to rates
- tlt_change_percent (REAL): Treasury bond ETF daily percentage change | Trading Context: Bond market performance
- gld_close (REAL): Gold ETF closing price | Trading Context: Gold commodity proxy, safe haven asset
- gld_change_percent (REAL): Gold ETF daily percentage change | Trading Context: Precious metals performance
- uup_close (REAL): US Dollar index ETF closing price | Trading Context: Dollar strength proxy
- uup_change_percent (REAL): US Dollar index ETF daily percentage change | Trading Context: Currency strength performance
- trade_date (DATE): Trading date in YYYY-MM-DD format | Trading Context: Settlement date for all metrics
- created_at (TEXT): Timestamp when record was inserted | Trading Context: Data collection timing

Table: historical_prices
Description: Daily OHLC stock price data with volume and technical indicators

Columns:
- symbol (TEXT): Stock ticker symbol | Trading Context: Primary key for stock identification
- trade_date (DATE): Trading date in YYYY-MM-DD format | Trading Context: Price data settlement date
- open_price (REAL): Opening price in dollars | Trading Context: Gap analysis vs previous close
- high_price (REAL): Daily high price in dollars | Trading Context: Resistance level identification
- low_price (REAL): Daily low price in dollars | Trading Context: Support level identification  
- close_price (REAL): Closing price in dollars | Trading Context: Settlement price for options calculations
- adj_close_price (REAL): Dividend/split adjusted closing price | Trading Context: Historical analysis and backtesting
- volume (REAL): Number of shares traded | Trading Context: Liquidity and institutional interest indicator
- change_amount (REAL): Dollar change from previous close | Trading Context: Absolute price movement
- change_percent (REAL): Percentage change from previous close | Trading Context: Relative performance measure
- vwap (REAL): Volume weighted average price | Trading Context: Institutional execution benchmark
- created_at (TEXT): Timestamp when record was inserted | Trading Context: Data collection timing

Table: earnings_calendar
Description: Corporate earnings announcements and estimates with actual results

Columns:
- id (INTEGER): Unique identifier for earnings record
- symbol (TEXT): Stock ticker symbol | Trading Context: Links to options activity analysis
- company_name (TEXT): Full company name | Trading Context: Corporate identification
- earnings_date (DATE): Scheduled earnings announcement date | Trading Context: Critical for options expiration timing
- earnings_time (TEXT): Time of earnings release | Trading Context: Before/after market hours affects strategy | Valid Values: 'BMO' (before market open), 'AMC' (after market close)
- fiscal_quarter (TEXT): Company's fiscal quarter | Trading Context: Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4 seasonal patterns
- fiscal_year (INTEGER): Company's fiscal year | Trading Context: Year-over-year comparison context
- eps_estimate (REAL): Estimated earnings per share | Trading Context: Consensus expectation for surprise analysis
- eps_actual (REAL): Actual reported earnings per share | Trading Context: Beat/miss calculation vs estimate
- revenue_estimate (REAL): Estimated revenue in millions | Trading Context: Top-line growth expectations
- revenue_actual (REAL): Actual reported revenue in millions | Trading Context: Beat/miss vs revenue estimate
- announcement_date (DATE): When earnings were actually announced | Trading Context: May differ from scheduled date
- eps_estimate_consensus (REAL): Analyst consensus EPS estimate | Trading Context: More refined estimate than single estimate
- eps_estimate_high (REAL): Highest analyst EPS estimate | Trading Context: Bull case expectation
- eps_estimate_low (REAL): Lowest analyst EPS estimate | Trading Context: Bear case expectation
- revenue_estimate_consensus (INTEGER): Analyst consensus revenue estimate | Trading Context: Revenue expectations in millions
- revenue_estimate_high (INTEGER): Highest analyst revenue estimate | Trading Context: Optimistic revenue scenario
- revenue_estimate_low (INTEGER): Lowest analyst revenue estimate | Trading Context: Conservative revenue scenario
- estimate_source (TEXT): Source of estimate data | Trading Context: Data provider identification
- created_at (TEXT): Timestamp when record was inserted
- updated_at (TEXT): Timestamp when record was last updated

Table: oi_daily
Description: Daily Open Interest Delta (OID) tracking with momentum analysis for individual option contracts
Trading Context: OI is a lagging indicator - today's OI data reflects overnight updates, not real-time changes. Used for directional stock movement inference.

Columns:
- contract_hash (TEXT): Unique identifier for option contract | Trading Context: Links to option_contracts table
- symbol (TEXT): Stock ticker symbol | Trading Context: Primary symbol for OI analysis
- strike (REAL): Option strike price | Trading Context: Strike where institutional positioning is concentrated
- expiration_date (TEXT): Option expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format | Trading Context: Time horizon for position
- option_type (TEXT): Call or put designation | Trading Context: Directional bias indicator | Values: 'call', 'put'
- trade_date (TEXT): Date of OI data snapshot | Trading Context: OI updates overnight, fixed during trading day
- volume (INTEGER): Daily trading volume | Trading Context: Liquidity and activity level
- open_interest (INTEGER): Total outstanding contracts | Trading Context: Institutional commitment level
- oi_change (INTEGER): Daily OI change in contracts | Trading Context: New positions added/removed overnight
- oi_change_pct (REAL): Daily OI percentage change | Trading Context: Relative growth/decline rate
- oi_change_1d (INTEGER): 1-day OI change | Trading Context: Short-term momentum
- oi_change_5d (INTEGER): 5-day OI change | Trading Context: Weekly trend analysis
- oi_change_10d (INTEGER): 10-day OI change | Trading Context: Multi-week trend analysis
- oi_change_pct_1d (REAL): 1-day OI percentage change | Trading Context: Short-term growth rate
- oi_change_pct_5d (REAL): 5-day OI percentage change | Trading Context: Weekly growth rate
- oi_change_pct_10d (REAL): 10-day OI percentage change | Trading Context: Multi-week growth rate
- oi_momentum_5d (REAL): 5-day momentum indicator | Trading Context: Accelerating/decelerating OI growth
- is_interesting (BOOLEAN): Flag for significant OI activity | Trading Context: Algorithmic filter for notable contracts
- gap_from_max_pct (REAL): Percentage gap from historical OI maximum | Trading Context: Relative positioning vs historical peaks
- interesting_reason (TEXT): Explanation for interesting classification | Trading Context: Algorithmic reasoning for flagging
- oi_rank_in_group (INTEGER): Ranking within symbol/expiration group | Trading Context: Strike concentration analysis
- group_max_oi (REAL): Highest OI in symbol/expiration group | Trading Context: Maximum institutional commitment level
- group_contract_count (INTEGER): Total contracts in group | Trading Context: Strike dispersion analysis
- interesting_since_date (TEXT): Date when contract became interesting | Trading Context: Duration of institutional interest
- days_interesting (INTEGER): Consecutive days flagged as interesting | Trading Context: Sustained attention indicator
- build_pattern (TEXT): OI accumulation pattern | Trading Context: Building vs unwinding identification
- was_interesting (BOOLEAN): Previously flagged status | Trading Context: Historical interest tracking
- concentration_ratio (REAL): OI concentration vs peers | Trading Context: Relative positioning strength
- concentration_change (REAL): Change in concentration ratio | Trading Context: Increasing/decreasing focus
- relative_concentration (REAL): Normalized concentration score | Trading Context: Cross-symbol comparison metric
- building_unwinding (TEXT): Directional OI trend | Trading Context: Institutional flow direction | Values: 'building', 'unwinding', 'neutral'
- institutional_score (REAL): Composite institutional interest score | Trading Context: Multi-factor positioning strength
- percentile_rank (REAL): Historical percentile ranking | Trading Context: Relative to historical OI levels
- statistical_z_score (REAL): Statistical significance of OI level | Trading Context: How many standard deviations from mean
- group_median_oi (REAL): Median OI in symbol/expiration group | Trading Context: Typical OI level for comparison
- symbol_exp_type_hash (TEXT): Symbol/expiration/type group identifier | Trading Context: Grouping key for analysis
- analysis_pending (BOOLEAN): Awaiting further analysis | Trading Context: Processing queue status
- processing_tier (TEXT): Priority level for analysis | Trading Context: High/medium/low priority processing
- last_analyzed_date (TEXT): Most recent analysis timestamp | Trading Context: Data freshness indicator
- created_at (TEXT): Record creation timestamp | Trading Context: Data collection timing

Table: oi_symbol_summary
Description: Daily symbol-level Open Interest summary with top strike identification
Trading Context: Aggregated OI data for directional bias analysis and major strike level identification

Columns:
- symbol (TEXT): Stock ticker symbol | Trading Context: Primary key for symbol-level OI analysis
- trade_date (TEXT): Date of OI data snapshot | Trading Context: Daily OI summary date
- total_open_interest (INTEGER): Sum of all OI across strikes/expirations | Trading Context: Total institutional commitment in symbol
- total_call_oi (INTEGER): Total call option open interest | Trading Context: Bullish positioning magnitude
- total_put_oi (INTEGER): Total put option open interest | Trading Context: Bearish/hedging positioning magnitude
- put_call_ratio (REAL): Ratio of put OI to call OI | Trading Context: >1.0 = bearish bias, <1.0 = bullish bias
- oi_balance_text (TEXT): Textual description of OI balance | Trading Context: Human-readable bias summary
- top_call_strike (REAL): Strike with highest call OI | Trading Context: Major bullish target/resistance level
- top_call_expiration (TEXT): Expiration of top call strike | Trading Context: Time horizon for bullish positioning
- top_call_oi (INTEGER): OI amount at top call strike | Trading Context: Magnitude of bullish commitment
- top_call_pct_of_total (REAL): Percentage of total call OI at top strike | Trading Context: Concentration vs dispersion
- top_call_display (TEXT): Human-readable top call description | Trading Context: Summary for display purposes
- top_call_hash (TEXT): Hash identifier for top call contract | Trading Context: Links to oi_daily table
- top_put_strike (REAL): Strike with highest put OI | Trading Context: Major bearish target/support level
- top_put_expiration (TEXT): Expiration of top put strike | Trading Context: Time horizon for bearish positioning
- top_put_oi (INTEGER): OI amount at top put strike | Trading Context: Magnitude of bearish/hedging commitment
- top_put_pct_of_total (REAL): Percentage of total put OI at top strike | Trading Context: Put concentration analysis
- top_put_display (TEXT): Human-readable top put description | Trading Context: Summary for display purposes
- top_put_hash (TEXT): Hash identifier for top put contract | Trading Context: Links to oi_daily table
- interesting_strikes_count (INTEGER): Number of strikes flagged as interesting | Trading Context: Breadth of institutional interest
- building_contracts_count (INTEGER): Number of contracts with building OI | Trading Context: New position establishment rate
- unwinding_contracts_count (INTEGER): Number of contracts with unwinding OI | Trading Context: Position closure rate
- analysis_timestamp (TEXT): When analysis was performed | Trading Context: Data processing timestamp
- processing_duration_ms (INTEGER): Analysis processing time in milliseconds | Trading Context: Performance monitoring
Significance score is a measure from 0-10 of how unusual an options flow is, with higher scores indicating more unusual activity.
Flow alerts are generated when options activity meets certain thresholds for unusualness based on volume, open interest, and statistical analysis.
Strike price is the price at which an option can be exercised. It's a key component of option contracts.
Expiration date is when an option contract expires and becomes worthless if not exercised.
Volume represents the number of option contracts traded during a specific period.
Open interest is the total number of outstanding option contracts that have not been settled.
Call options give the holder the right to buy the underlying stock at the strike price.
Put options give the holder the right to sell the underlying stock at the strike price.
Moneyness describes whether an option is in-the-money (ITM), at-the-money (ATM), or out-of-the-money (OTM).
The underlying price is the current market price of the stock that the option is based on.
Implied volatility (IV) reflects the market's expectation of future volatility in the underlying stock.
Premium value is the total dollar amount of options contracts, calculated as price × volume × 100.
Days to expiration (DTE) is the number of calendar days until the option expires.
The Greeks (delta, gamma, theta, vega) measure various risk sensitivities of options.
Alert timestamps are stored in Eastern Time (EST/EDT) to match market hours.
